app.name: Tally
app.tagline: Record points, see the ranking, share it.
landing.title: A leaderboard for your club
landing.lead: Record the score of every match, points add up automatically for each player, then share this season's ranking with the group.
landing.cta_login: Already have an account? Log in
landing.step1.title: Create a tally
landing.step1.body: Pick the sport (e.g. badminton), the season, and the points rule.
landing.step2.title: Record matches
landing.step2.body: Tick who showed up, shuffle the pairs, enter the scores. Points are counted instantly.
landing.step3.title: Share the ranking
landing.step3.body: Send the link or a ranking poster to the group.
login.title: Log in
register.title: Create an account
register.lead: Accounts are for admins who run a tally. Players are just names, they don't need an account.
err.username_short: Username must be at least 3 characters.
err.username_long: Username can be at most 30 characters.
err.username_chars: Username may only contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscore (_).
err.username_taken: That username is taken. Pick another or log in.
err.password_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
dashboard.title: My tallies
dashboard.empty: No tallies yet. Create your first one below.
notfound.title: Page not found
score.err.target: Target points must be between 1 and 999.
score.err.games: Number of games must be between 1 and 5.
score.err.bonus: Win bonus must be between 0 and 999.
score.err.tie: The score can't be a tie.
create.title: Create a new tally
create.name: Name
setup.title: Getting started
setup.period: Create a season and its points rule
share.title: Link to share
players.first_hint: Your tally is ready. Start by typing in the players' names.
players.names_hint: (one per line; a list pasted from a group chat works too)
players.deactivate_help: Inactive players aren't offered when picking players, but their points stay. Delete only works for players with no matches yet.
period.name: Season name
period.first_hint: A season sets the ranking's time range and its points rule.
format.continuous_help: One running score, e.g. to 42. Game two carries on from game one's score.
format.reset_help: Each game starts at 0, e.g. 21-9, 21-19. 1-1 counts as a draw.
settings.title: Tally settings
visibility.title: Who can view
visibility.link_help: Share the link with the group; they can view without an account.
visibility.private_help: Only this tally's admins can open the link.
admins.title: Admins
admins.help: Admins can manage players, seasons, and matches. Only the owner can add or remove admins.
err.name_long: Name can be at most %d characters.
err.desc_long: Description can be at most %d characters.
err.slug_short: Link must be at least 3 characters.
err.slug_long: Link can be at most 40 characters.
err.slug_chars: Link may only contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
err.slug_taken: That link is taken. Pick another.
err.player_exists: There's already a player with that name.
err.player_in_use: This player already has matches or points. Deactivate them instead.
err.date: Enter a start and end date.
err.date_order: End date can't be before the start date.
err.admin_not_found: No account with username "%s". Ask them to sign up or log in to Tally once first.
play.no_period: Create a season before recording matches.
play.start_help: Pick the play day's date. Who's here follows from the points entered; courts and attendance for shuffling can be set on the play day.
round.label: Week %s
round.no_court: Nobody's on court. Press Shuffle pairs to fill the courts.
round.shuffle_help: Whoever has played least today goes first; pairs are random.
round.all_busy: All courts are busy. Save a score first.
round.add_manual_help: For a match with pairs picked by hand.
match.delete_confirm: Delete this match? Its points are removed too.
period.scored_note: This season has matches. The score format can't change; changing the win bonus recalculates every match's points.
err.courts_busy: All courts are busy. Save a score or cancel a match first.
err.not_enough_players: Needs at least %d players who are here and not on court.
err.match_scores: Fill in every score as a number.
err.scoring_locked: The score format can't change because this season already has matches.
err.rounds_outside: Some play days fall outside the new dates. Adjust the dates.
poster.title: Poster
poster.failed: Couldn't make the image. Try again, or take a screenshot.
poster.help: A 1024×1536 image to share in a WhatsApp group or on Instagram.
branding.help: All optional. With no title, the tally name is used, split over two lines.
branding.logo_hint: (optional; PNG, JPG, or WebP, max 1 MB)
err.logo_type: The logo must be a PNG, JPG, or WebP.
err.logo_too_big: The logo is too big (max 1 MB and 4096 px a side).
err.logo_invalid: The logo file can't be read.
err.brand_long: Poster text can be at most %d characters.
preset.duel.help: Chess, table tennis, arm wrestling, games… Win/draw/loss or score.
preset.team.help: Futsal, basketball, volleyball… Teams are shuffled every match.
preset.counter.help: No opponents: attendance, quizzes, habits, goals… Points are entered directly.
format.outcome_help: Enter the final score; points follow the result (e.g. 3/1/0). Equal score = draw.
rule.counter: Points are entered directly for each player.
score.err.outcome_pts: Win/draw/loss points must be between 0 and 999.
awards.title: Extra points
err.award_empty: Enter points for at least one player.
round.cancel_confirm: Cancel this match? Its players go back to the waiting list.
autherror.title: Couldn't log in
auth.err.unavailable: The login service is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
auth.err.state: The login session is invalid or has expired.
auth.err.exchange: Couldn't finish logging in. Please try again.
auth.err.verify: Couldn't verify your identity. Please try again.
auth.err.unlinked: This username already belongs to an older Tally account. Ask the admin to link it to your All-in-one account.
guide.title: Guide
guide.lead: How to use Tally from the start: creating a tally, running a play day, and sharing the leaderboard and poster.
admin.title: Site admin: users
admin.lead: Read-only. Every account and its activity; open a user to see their tallies. Every view is recorded.
admin.no_tallies: This user doesn't run any tally.
admin.private_note: Private tallies are listed but can't be opened from here.
admin.unavailable.title: Site admin unavailable
admin.unavailable.body: Admin status can't be checked because all-in-one can't be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
account.title: Account
account.managed: Your Tally account is managed by All-in-one, so your password and email are changed there, not in Tally.
account.add_email: Add an email so you can reset your password yourself if you forget it.
account.leaving: 🔒 You'll be taken to %s, where your account is managed. Only enter your password on that address.
score.title: Enter points
score.help: Type a player's name or pick it from the list, enter the points (0–%d), then press Add. Each entry is one play.
score.new_player: "%s" isn't a player yet. Add them as a new player?
score.chips_help: Tap a white number to delete it, + to add points for that player. Grey numbers come from matches; tap one to open it on the Matches tab, where matches are edited or deleted.
score.chip_match: From a match · tap to open it
err.score_range: Points must be a number from 0 to %d.
err.score_retry: A player with that name was just added. Press Add again.
board.points_only: This play day's points were entered without match details.
awards.extra_help: One player per entry: a positive number for a bonus, negative for a penalty. The note is optional. It doesn't count as a play.
err.extra_unknown: "%s" isn't a player. Pick a name from the list.
play.season_none: This date isn't in any season.
